unitSoil: Water in the topsoil, m³ per m³
unitNdvi: Plant greenness index (NDVI), 0 is bare, 1 is lush
unitAerosol: Aerosol index; higher means thicker smoke or dust
fwiNote: Index values. Our risk levels are separate and do not use these bands.
landOther: Wetland, towns, snow, bare ground, water
windArrow: Points where the wind blows to
heatNote: The glow blends neighbouring 0.25 degree cells so patterns read at any zoom. The report on the right gives the exact figures for a place.
